title: Trump 'not concerned' about South China Sea as he meets Marcos in Malacañang
summary: United States President Donald Trump said he was not concerned about the situation in the hotly contested South China Sea.

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump speaks at the ASEAN-US Special Summit on Nov. 17, 2026.
MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump said he was not concerned about the situation in the hotly contested South China Sea.

“I’m not concerned at all. That’ll be taken care of,” Trump said at the start of bilateral talks with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday, November 18, hours before flying to China to meet Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin.
Trump also told reporters that the US alliance with the Philippines "has never been better" and that Washington and Manila were expanding their defense cooperation.
Marcos was expected to use the meeting to press for stronger US security commitments as China steps up its activities in the tense waterways.
